description: This file contains PHP functions related to SuiteCRM installation and configuration, including setting up hooks, templates, and configuration parameters for the AdvancedOpenPortal module.

methods.name: install_aop
methods.description: Initializes configuration for AdvancedOpenPortal, loads email templates, and installs hooks.

methods.name: installAOPHooks
methods.description: Sets up logic hooks for various modules in SuiteCRM, such as Contacts, Cases, and Emails.

methods.name: getTemplates
methods.description: Returns an array of email templates used within the AdvancedOpenPortal module.
